candidates.description: This feature activates on common character sequences and subword units from Devanagari script and numeric tokens.
This vector represents common Devanagari vowel and consonant combinations frequently found in Hindi word roots and suffixes.
This vector represents Devanagari character sequences involving nasal consonants combined with other consonants.
This feature vector is related to Hindi vowel matras (diacritics) combined with punctuation marks.
This vector activates on rare, miscellaneous characters and Devanagari script fragments, lacking a unified semantic concept.
This feature vector represents common Devanagari word suffixes and phonetic endings used in Hindi text.
This vector activates on Hindi and Greek suffix and vowel sign tokens used in inflectional morphology.
This vector activates for Hindi vowel signs, matras, and nasalization marks attached to consonants.
These tokens represent demonstrative pronouns, oblique case markers, and common morphological roots in the Hindi language.
These tokens represent common Hindi verb suffixes, inflectional endings, and root-affix combinations used for tense, aspect, and gender agreement.
